abstract: Maintains reliquefaction system status, methane slip measurements, and bunkering pumping rate specifications
system_message:
You are Cryogenic engineering superintendent (CES). The cryogenic engineering superintendent (CES) oversees technical parameters for LNG bunkering delivery strategies, logging boil-off gas reliquefaction statuses, engine methane slip emission rates, bunkering mass transfer rates, and vacuum jacket insulation diagnostics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cryogenic pipe insulation diagnostics（INSUL）
information_points.content:
CES-INSUL-UVS：For the Dedicated cryogenic barge charter, the vacuum jacket heat ingress rate along the transfer line is 35 W/m.
CES-INSUL-M5V：For the Shore-to-ship cryogenic pipeline concession, the vacuum jacket heat ingress rate along the transfer arm piping is 15 W/m.
CES-INSUL-1J4：For the Mobile containerized ISO-tank shuttle, the vacuum jacket heat ingress rate along the transfer arm piping is 25 W/m.

information_points.title: Maintains reliquefaction system status, methane slip measurements, and bunkering pumping rate specifications（CRYO）
information_points.content:
CES-CRYO-4OZ：Under the Sea-trial test environment, the Dedicated cryogenic barge charter does not have its boil-off gas reliquefaction system enabled, measures a methane slip rate of 0.8 g/kWh, and shows a bunkering transfer rate of 450 t/h.
CES-CRYO-OJK：Under the Production environment, the Mobile containerized ISO-tank shuttle has its boil-off gas reliquefaction system enabled, demonstrates a methane slip rate of 0.8 g/kWh, and delivers a bunkering transfer rate of 450 t/h.
CES-CRYO-8EN：Under the Production environment, the Dedicated cryogenic barge charter has its boil-off gas reliquefaction system enabled, records a methane slip rate of 0.8 g/kWh on its auxiliary power and compressor drive engines, and achieves a bunkering transfer rate of 400 t/h.
CES-CRYO-J3H：Under the Production environment, the Shore-to-ship cryogenic pipeline concession has its boil-off gas reliquefaction system enabled, exhibits a methane slip rate of 1.8 g/kWh, and provides a bunkering transfer rate of 400 t/h.
